An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''stormtrooper''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. He shot [[Skosef]] after the [[General/Legends|General]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bartam]].
